description: §14.8.9 S456 negative control — handle() builds its response with `globalThis.Response` / an alias of it from NON-protected fields of a protected row: compiles, no E-PROTECT-006.
rationale: The S456 fix recognizes the Response constructor by value and makes handle()'s return a sink; neither may reject a handle() that sends only non-protected data (§40 keeps handle() an author-owned escape hatch).
